name: Gareth Lloyd
bio: Meet Gareth, a passionate iOS developer and current mobile tech lead at Kogan.com. With over seven years of expertise, he brings a wealth of experience to the table. Originally from Scotland, Gareth embarked on a new chapter by moving to Australia in January 2023. His professional journey has predominantly focused on retail apps, where he has left his mark working with a number of major UK brands such as Selfridges, River Island, and Wetherspoons before joining Kogan.com.
